title: Missing doc comments on pub(crate) functions
description:
File: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/kdf.rs
Lines: 30, 43, 104

Functions lack comprehensive doc comments:
- hkdf_extract (line 30): Has one-liner but no param docs
- edhoc_kdf (lines 43-48): Has brief doc but missing:
  - `# Errors` section documenting error conditions
  - Length limits (max 128 bytes output, max 255 bytes context)
- export_context (line 104): No doc comment at all

Per Rust standards, pub(crate) items should document:
- Parameters and return value
- Error conditions
- Panic conditions (none here)
- Any size/length limits
